summary.text: John Lujan represents Texas House District 118 in South, East and Northeast Bexar County; he was first elected in 2016 and re-elected in 2021. He chairs the House International Relations Subcommittee and is vice chair of the Appropriations Subcommittee for Articles VI, VII and VIII.

paragraphs.text: Lujan was born and raised on the Southside of San Antonio; his mother was a public school principal and his father a local pastor.
He began his career in public safety as a Bexar County Sheriff's Deputy for five years and then served over 25 years with the San Antonio Fire Department.
He helped grow a local IT firm that employs more than 500 people across Bexar County.
He lives on a small ranch in South San Antonio with his wife, Freda, attends Southside Baptist Church and teaches Sunday School there.
